answer.reason: The verses tell of Herod's killing of James, his imprisonment of Peter, and his death at the hand of an angel.

clauses.english: killed James the brother of John with the sword
clauses.quote: he killed James the brother of John with the sword

clauses.english: imprisoned Peter under guard of soldiers
clauses.quote: he put him in prison, and delivered him to four quaternions of soldiers

clauses.english: was struck by the angel of the Lord and died, eaten of worms
clauses.quote: the angel of the Lord smote him

doubts: ACT 23:35 (Herod's judgment hall) names a building of another Herod, not this king, so it was left out.
